static_observation.proof_boundary: This is materially stronger than pre-load hashing alone and may be sufficient for a bounded exact-source loader-input identity claim. However, pathname-open observation is not by itself a direct digest of the in-memory parameters/buffers that actually participate in the observed forward. The current name consumed_identity_match therefore requires an explicit acceptance theorem or a stronger model-state attestation challenger before it is treated as a general loader-consumption theorem.
static_observation.why_this_matters: EntityOS/HCU evidence law already distinguishes artifact hashing from verified loader consumption. Trigger-2 checkpoint selection must not accidentally promote an input-path observation into a broader claim than the probe has falsifiably established.

hypotheses.claim: For this exact trusted offline child source, requiring every expected shard to be opened, manifest-hash equal before and after load, plus a successful forward and exact input identity is sufficient for bounded checkpoint selection identity.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The same path-level evidence can coexist with a different active in-memory parameter state, so consumed_identity_match overstates the causal binding unless active module state is independently bound.

hypotheses.claim: A deterministic digest over the actually loaded model parameters and persistent buffers, bound to the observed forward and exact source/runtime/input receipt, gives a more direct checkpoint-to-forward identity than merely adding read/pread/mmap syscall classes.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Hashing the full module state is unnecessarily expensive and duplicates guarantees already provided by trusted exact source plus manifest/open/forward evidence.

recommended_discriminator.primary: Extend the selection-grade receipt with a deterministic post-load module-state digest over named_parameters plus persistent buffers using stable name/dtype/shape/content framing, then bind that digest to the same forward/input/runtime receipt. Compare it across frozen repeat loads of the same candidate and across the three candidates.
recommended_discriminator.adversarial_negative: A dedicated test fixture that opens/hash-validates the expected frozen bundle but intentionally constructs the active model state from a different manifest-bound fixture must be rejected by the stronger state-attestation gate even if simple pathname-open evidence is present.
recommended_discriminator.secondary: If full active-state hashing is too costly, explicitly downgrade the v1 semantic label to LOADER_OPEN_INPUT_IDENTITY and preregister the exact weaker claim rather than calling it full consumed-state identity.
recommended_discriminator.syscall_note: Tracing mmap/pread/read may improve storage-path observability but should not be treated as a complete substitute for binding the active module state that performs the forward.
